Authentic Yeola Paithani, Pure Silk & Bridal Sarees in Kolhapur

Welcome to Swarada Saree Center (स्वरदा साडी सेंटर), Kolhapur's premier destination for genuine Yeola Paithani, pure Banarasi silk, and handcrafted bridal wear. Located at Mahadwar Road near Mahalaxmi Mandir, Kolhapur, we bring authentic handloom drapes directly from master weaver looms to patrons across India and worldwide.
